$comment: Cross-era portrait: Moltke the Elder is referenced by the 1914 pack's prologue (sand-1l0.3) and will be reused by a future 1870 pack.

original.description: Bust portrait of Helmuth von Moltke the Elder in the dark undress tunic of a Prussian general officer, with braided shoulder boards and a star order at the collar. Taken during his tenure as Chief of the Prussian General Staff.
original.archive: Bibliothèque nationale de France (Gallica); the file used is the Wikimedia Commons crop of the Gallica scan
original.licence: public domain — photographer died 1905, photograph taken in the 1870s; Commons: public domain

colorization.author: Dave Tashner / Sandtable
colorization.method: AI-assisted colorization and upscale from the public-domain original, 2026
colorization.licence: Sandtable project licence; underlying photograph public domain
colorization.status: ok — label 'colorized (AI-assisted)'. Documented colours: Prussian general officers' tunic dark blue with gold-braid shoulder boards. NOT verified: the enamel star at the collar (order not identified) and the eye colour are colorizer choices — flag for the image review (sand-y0u.7).

caption: Helmuth von Moltke the Elder (1800–1891), Chief of the Prussian General Staff, photographed by Carl Günther in the 1870s. Colorized (AI-assisted) from a public-domain photograph.
credit: Original photograph: Carl Günther, 1870s; Bibliothèque nationale de France (Gallica), via Wikimedia Commons; public domain. Colorization: Sandtable, AI-assisted, 2026.
notes: Provided by Dave 2026-08-23. Intended placement: the Person card and the prologue's descent-of-doctrine pair (elder Moltke → Schlieffen → the younger Moltke); used_by is deliberately empty until the prologue beats exist (sand-1l0.3), since the validator warns on ids that do not yet exist. The upscale means the rendered image carries more apparent detail than the 410 × 549 source — do not read insignia from it.
